column1: # A person's profile, as Phiegg's has it: its tabs, in order. A tab's
# key, what it shows, and its word (text.tsv). What it shows: `picture`,
# the pictures they posted, in a grid, each opening in the viewer;
# `club`, the clubs they hold, as cards; `space`, the spaces they are
# in, as cards, each going to its first room; `linked`, who they are
# linked to, as cards, each opening them. A tab with nothing in it is
# not shown. The counts over the tabs are Phiegg's own (site.tsv
# `person.count`), each named by `person.count.` and its word.
